description: This file defines JavaScript functions and objects for handling Drupal's big pipe processing with htmx integration, including command execution queue, DOM manipulation commands, redirects, settings updates, CSS/JS addition, and messaging.

methods.name: commandExecutionQueue
methods.description: Ensures that Drupal Ajax commands are executed sequentially, handling promises returned by commands.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts new content into the DOM at specified targets, mapping jQuery methods to DOM operations.

methods.name: redirect
methods.description: Redirects the browser to a specified URL.

methods.name: settings
methods.description: Updates global settings with new settings, optionally merging them.

methods.name: add_css
methods.description: Adds CSS assets to the page.

methods.name: message
methods.description: Displays a message in a specified message zone, optionally clearing previous messages.

methods.name: add_js
methods.description: Adds JavaScript assets to the page and triggers a load event.
